records.subject: You're in -- let's get Union Group set up
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Welcome to Wrenfield! Your workspace is ready. A good first step is to create your first project and invite a teammate.

If anything's unclear, just reply here.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Union Group* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Six days since signup with no reply to the welcome email [email:39ccc0f2], no tickets, no project, no invite. No engagement signal of any kind, so self-starting within the remaining 8 days looks unlikely though not impossible on a Starter plan.

draft.subject: A quick hand getting Union Group's first project up
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Checking in since your Wrenfield workspace went live last week. If it helps, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Chidi
